consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance had its highlights, particularly with the last rendition of 'Comes A Time,' which was both touching and well-executed. While some songs were praised, there were also mentions of vocal miscues and an overall average performance in certain areas.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.2 for 24 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: The show had notable moments, especially with 'Comes A Time,' but overall performance quality was inconsistent, leading to a mixed reception.
